name: attendance
definition: 记录某一成员在某一活动中出勤情况的信息条目,以成员与活动的关联为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:成员是参与活动的人,出勤记录只是描述参与情况的信息条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table attendance; provenance: direct source attendance

name: budget
definition: 为某一活动按类别核定并跟踪已用与剩余金额的财务信息条目,以所属活动与预算类别为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与支出(expense)混淆:预算是事先核定的额度,支出是实际发生的费用 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table budget; provenance: direct source budget

name: event
definition: 在特定日期与地点发生、具有名称、类型与状态的业务事件,以发生时间与地点为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与预算(budget)混淆:活动是实际发生的事项,预算是围绕该事项的财务安排 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table event; provenance: direct source event

name: expense
definition: 由某一成员发生、计入某一预算并记录金额与审批状态的费用信息条目,以发生成员与所属预算为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与收入(income)混淆:支出是资金流出,收入是资金流入 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table expense; provenance: direct source expense

name: income
definition: 由某一成员经手、记录到账日期、金额与来源的资金流入信息条目,以经手成员与来源为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与支出(expense)混淆:收入是资金流入,支出是资金流出 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table income; provenance: direct source income

name: major
definition: 隶属于某一院系与学院、具有名称的学科专业目录条目,以所属院系与学院为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:专业是学科目录条目,成员是就读或任职于该专业的人 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table major; provenance: direct source major

name: member
definition: 隶属于某一专业、具有姓名、职务与联系方式等属性的组织参与者,以所属专业为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与专业(major)混淆:成员是具体的人,专业是其所属的学科目录条目 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table member; provenance: direct source member

name: zip_code
definition: 标识城市、县、州等行政区划的邮政编码目录条目,以编码对应的行政区划为区别特征 Counterexample: 易与成员(member)混淆:邮政编码是地址目录条目,成员是持有该编码地址的人 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table zip_code; provenance: direct source zip_code

name: MemberTShirtSize
definition: The t-shirt size of a member.

name: MemberPosition
definition: The role/position a member holds in the organization.

name: EventName
definition: The name of an event.

name: EventType
definition: The type/category of an event (e.g., Game, Fundraiser, Meeting).

name: EventStatus
definition: The current status of an event (e.g., Closed, Open).

name: EventLocation
definition: The location where an event was held.

name: EventDate
definition: The date an event occurred.

name: BudgetCategory
definition: The category of a budget line item.

name: BudgetAmount
definition: The amount budgeted for a budget line item.

name: BudgetSpent
definition: The amount actually spent against a budget.

name: BudgetRemaining
definition: The remaining budget after spending.

name: ExpenseCost
definition: The cost of an expense line item.

name: ExpenseDescription
definition: The description of what an expense was for.

name: ExpenseDate
definition: The date an expense was incurred.

name: ExpenseApproved
definition: Whether an expense was approved.

name: IncomeAmount
definition: The amount of income received.

name: IncomeSource
definition: The source of an income record (e.g., Fundraising, Dues).

name: IncomeDateReceived
definition: The date income was received.

name: IncomeNotes
definition: Notes attached to an income record.

name: TotalBudgetAmount
definition: Sum of all budgeted amounts. Formula: SUM(BudgetAmount). Inputs: BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: TotalBudgetSpent
definition: Sum of all spent amounts in budgets. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpent). Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent

name: TotalExpenseCost
definition: Sum of all expense costs. Formula: SUM(ExpenseCost). Inputs: ExpenseCost = expense.cost

name: TotalIncomeAmount
definition: Sum of all income amounts. Formula: SUM(IncomeAmount). Inputs: IncomeAmount = income.amount

name: BudgetUtilizationRate
definition: Ratio of spent to budgeted amount. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpent) / SUM(BudgetAmount). Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent; BudgetAmount = budget.amount

name: YearOverYearSpentDifference
definition: Difference in total spent between two years. Formula: SUM(BudgetSpent for year1) - SUM(BudgetSpent for year2). Inputs: BudgetSpent = budget.spent; EventDate = event.event_date

name: IncomeCountByAmount
definition: Count of income records for a specific amount. Formula: COUNT(IncomeAmount) WHERE IncomeAmount = value. Inputs: IncomeAmount = income.amount

name: EventType
definition: Categorizes events by their type.

name: EventStatus
definition: Categorizes events by their status.

name: IncomeSource
definition: Categorizes income by its source.

name: MemberPosition
definition: Categorizes members by their position.

name: TShirtSize
definition: Categorizes members by t-shirt size.
